terminus.finding: A 2009 community aging paper by 薛方杰 and 潘冠志 explicitly defines community care as linking formal and informal resources and treats familiar people, places and social networks as support infrastructure. This does not prove formalization succeeds without loss, but it gives a design counterpoint to the prior function-migration finding: formal systems can be intentionally designed to preserve and connect informal relations rather than replace them.
terminus.candidate: Keep formal apparatus versus operative relational infrastructure, but distinguish replacement-type formalization from connector-type formalization.
terminus.next: seek empirical cases where connector-type formalization demonstrably works in practice
